title: Pilk is devastated

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Did you find the watch?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you find the watch?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not exactly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not exactly.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not exactly.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not exactly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's complicated.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's complicated.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's complicated.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's complicated.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: What does that mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's in the Spire, far out of reach.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's in the Spire, far out of reach.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's in the Spire, far out of reach.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's in the Spire, far out of reach.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No way to get it back. It has been destroyed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No way to get it back. It has been destroyed.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No way to get it back. It has been destroyed.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No way to get it back. It has been destroyed.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Destroyed? But how?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Destroyed? But how?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: As far as I heard an act of revenge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As far as I heard an act of revenge.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: As far as I heard an act of revenge.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: As far as I heard an act of revenge.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your cleaner had some grudge against you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your cleaner had some grudge against you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Your cleaner had some grudge against you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Your cleaner had some grudge against you?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Revenge? What revenge?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Revenge? What revenge?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: What? Just because I withheld his wages? I mean he had become so sloppy ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Just because I withheld his wages? I mean he had become so sloppy ...

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: ... that cannot be! What did he do with it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... that cannot be! What did he do with it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He wanted to sell it and got killed. And through that the watch fell into the harbor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He wanted to sell it and got killed. And through that the watch fell into the harbor.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He wanted to sell it and got killed. And through that the watch fell into the harbor.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He wanted to sell it and got killed. And through that the watch fell into the harbor.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: So we can still retrieve it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So we can still retrieve it!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The killers thought the same, but no chance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The killers thought the same, but no chance.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The killers thought the same, but no chance.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The killers thought the same, but no chance.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: What? But... I must get it. They'll kill me if I don't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? But... I must get it. They'll kill me if I don't.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Someone has to go to the Spire and bring it back!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone has to go to the Spire and bring it back!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe. But that won't be me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe. But that won't be me!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe. But that won't be me!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe. But that won't be me!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good luck finding that person.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good luck finding that person.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Good luck finding that person.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Good luck finding that person.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: I'll pay you 500 Lims!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll pay you 500 Lims!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not for 500,000. That watch is deadly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not for 500,000. That watch is deadly.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not for 500,000. That watch is deadly.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not for 500,000. That watch is deadly.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: But they will kill me! You cannot do this to me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But they will kill me! You cannot do this to me!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Find a way to vanish for a while.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Find a way to vanish for a while.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Find a way to vanish for a while.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Find a way to vanish for a while.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Turns out I can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Turns out I can.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Turns out I can.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Turns out I can.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: I'm going to terminate your tenancy. I'm going to make you homeless! I'll start the eviction process today!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm going to terminate your tenancy. I'm going to make you homeless! I'll start the eviction process today!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't recommend you make that the focus of the limited time you have left.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't recommend you make that the focus of the limited time you have left.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't recommend you make that the focus of the limited time you have left.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't recommend you make that the focus of the limited time you have left.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: But ... they will kill me! There must be a solution!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But ... they will kill me! There must be a solution!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Lay low for a while.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lay low for a while.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Lay low for a while.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Lay low for a while.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: That's devastating. It was such a masterpiece.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's devastating. It was such a masterpiece.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It was.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It was.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It was.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The watch fell into the sea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The watch fell into the sea.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The watch fell into the sea.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The watch fell into the sea.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The salt water completely destroyed it. Only 30 meters of water resistancy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The salt water completely destroyed it. Only 30 meters of water resistancy.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The salt water completely destroyed it. Only 30 meters of water resistancy.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The salt water completely destroyed it. Only 30 meters of water resistancy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Stay out of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Stay out of it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Stay out of it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Stay out of it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe they will find it some day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe they will find it some day.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe they will find it some day.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe they will find it some day.
